name: Cleansing Cascade

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds

disable: DC 25 Religion check (expert) to ceremonially purify everyone in the room, by pouring water from a tub over their hands, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the corrupted ritual magic.

items.name: Purifying Blast
items.text:
Trigger A living creature steps out of the room.

---

Effect Water sprays out of the tubs. Every creature in the room or within 10 feet of the doors takes 4d10+18 bludgeoning damage (DC 27 basic Reflex save save) and the water casts 4th-rank Dispel Magic with a counteract modifier of +15 against the highest-rank spell active on each target (or all spells on a target that critically fails its Reflex save).

text: The ritual power in this room, corrupted by necromantic energy, slams purifying water into all "unclean" creatures that try to leave.
